name: Scotiabank Passport Visa Infinite Business Card

localized_names.en: Scotiabank Passport Visa Infinite Business Card

apr.notes: 20.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash advances, balance transfers and cash-like transactions.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees; only the exchange rate applies.

credit_required.notes: One of: business annual sales revenue of $500,000, personal income of $60,000, household income of $100,000, $250,000 in assets under management, or $30,000 in annual card spend.

base_rate.description: 1.5 Scene+ points per $1 on business purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Scene+ points redeem for travel, groceries, dining, entertainment, gift cards and statement credits against purchases.

signup_bonus.description: 30,000 bonus Scene+ points after $5,000 in eligible business purchases in the first 3 months, plus 10,000 points after $60,000 in the first 12 months.

benefits.title: Airport lounge access
benefits.description: Access to over 1,200 airport lounges, including 6 complimentary lounge visits per year.

notes: Network tier is Visa Infinite per the card name.
